notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {2}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {2}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
